scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @telltale/contracts build && concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,green "pnpm --filter @telltale/web dev" "pnpm --filter @telltale/api dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @telltale/contracts build && pnpm --filter @telltale/api build && pnpm --filter @telltale/web build
scripts.build:worker: pnpm --filter @telltale/contracts build && pnpm --filter @telltale/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @telltale/web build
scripts.test:entry: pnpm --filter @telltale/contracts build && pnpm --filter @telltale/api test:entry && pnpm --filter @telltale/web test:entry
scripts.typecheck: pnpm check:dependencies && pnpm --filter @telltale/contracts build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test:database: pnpm check:dependencies && pnpm --filter @telltale/contracts build && pnpm --filter @telltale/api test:database
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm check:dependencies && pnpm --filter @telltale/contracts build && pnpm --filter @telltale/api db:migrate
scripts.test:integration: pnpm check:dependencies && pnpm test:entry && pnpm test:database && pnpm test:worker
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
